info.title: Nibras Code public API (Nibras QR, Site Doctor)
info.description: Two small public endpoints used by nibrascode.com. Free, no key. Please be gentle: Site Doctor allows one check per IP every 15 seconds.

get.summary: Make a QR code PNG (512px) from text or a URL

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text or URL to encode (max 500 characters).

post.summary: Technical and SEO check of a public website URL (Nibras Site Doctor)

200.description: JSON report (status, redirects, headers, meta tags, robots.txt, sitemap, links, assets)

429.description: Too many requests (one check per 15 seconds per IP)
